dagre-d3-es 7.0.10
Published package author: Thibaut Lassalle
Published package license declaration: MIT
The upstream README identifies this as an ES module fork of dagre-d3.
The npm archive and its recorded git revision omit a separate license file.
Inherited dagre-d3, dagre, and graphlib MIT notices are retained here.
This preserves known attribution; the fork's missing standalone notice remains
a provenance limitation in the engineering review.
